text: That's no reason to back out. text: Thank you. Yeah, I'll bear that in mind if I'm ever nominated for the Hillbilly Peace Prize.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Am I? Let me tell you a story.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I was 14 and graduating summa cum laude from college. Summa cum laude is Latin for with highest honours.

speaker: penny
text: I just love how you always skip over the part where no one asks.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I was valedictorian and expected to give an address. Even now, I can remember that moment when I walked up to the podium and looked out at the crowd. There must have been thousands of people. My heart started pounding in my chest. I began to hyperventilate. My vision became blurry, and before I knew it... oh, dear.
